answer: According to EDPB Statement 3/2024, data protection authorities (DPAs) must supervise the high-risk AI systems listed in points 1, 6, 7, and 8 of Annex III of the AI Act as market surveillance authorities. The EDPB recommends that DPAs, acting as market surveillance authorities, should be designated as the single points of contact for the public and counterparts at Member State and Union levels.
